reviews.comment: Dr. Reynolds is a very dedicated and caring professor. He makes himself very accessible to students and is super kind. This class feels fun because you actually learn technical skills but is not overwhelming as he helps at every step.

Dr.Reynolds is a smart and nice person. He helps you a lot outside of class . The criteria are clear, and I like the assignment projects. Coding is a little hard for me since I have zero experience but as long as I don't mess up on assignments and prepare for exams it's not very difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Reynolds is amazing and super easy to work with. He takes the time to get to know you and cares about your success. The class is made up of 2 projects weighing 40% combined and he makes what would be a very difficult process of writing the code much easier. The test for this class was also extremely easy if you do the homework.
